correction: C exit decision moved to the last reliable bar before the absent 16:00 ET bar.
5m: Decide at 15:50 ET; NEXT_BAR fill at the 15:55 ET open.
15m_fallback: Decide at 15:30 ET; NEXT_BAR fill at the 15:45 ET open.
reason: The first C implementation submitted at 15:55/15:45, but no next 16:00 bar existed. Native Engine deferred those exits into a later session. Those outputs are archived and excluded from final metrics.
verification: The native-engine fixture asserts entry fills exactly one 5m bar after the signal and exits at the same-session final reliable bar.
follow_up: Exclude each session unless both the 15:50/15:30 decision timestamp and 15:55/15:45 next-bar fill timestamp exist. This removes one NAS100 overnight exit caused by a missing fill bar.
signal_alignment_fix: Retain all price rows in the DataFeed. Preserve null signals on bars without entries so NEXT_BAR always means the next market bar, not the next signal row.
placebo_early_close_correction: Gate shifted C matched-time placebo signals to sessions with both the configured close decision bar and its next-bar fill bar. Previous placebo outputs are excluded because the shifted signal could enter a session without an exit bar.
archived_placebo_attempt: Previous placebo metrics and trade ledgers were overwritten by the corrected rerun; correction is documented here. The earlier outputs had no separate archive.
